Description: AB 2011 Ministerial Application. The proposed project is a transit-oriented in-fill development of 13 mixed-use and multi-family residential buildings totaling approximately 769,300 SF and one wrap garage structure with approximately 296 parking spaces in parking lots surrounding the North Berkeley BART Station. Buildings range in height from 3 to 8 stories and consist of 739 units with over 50% of the homes at affordable rent levels. The project includes improvements to the Ohlone Greenway and over 6,000 SF of community-serving ground floor uses as well as street and public realm upgrades, and over 48,000 SF of publicly accessible open space.
